HubSpot's AI layer across its CRM, marketing, sales and service hubs.

What is HubSpot Breeze?

HubSpot's AI layer across its CRM, marketing, sales and service hubs. Combines a copilot, a set of specialised agents (prospecting, customer, content, knowledge base) and Breeze Intelligence, which enriches CRM records with external company and contact data.

Best for

AI that acts directly on your CRM data inside HubSpot.

Main features

  • Breeze Copilot as an assistant across the CRM
  • Prospecting Agent researching leads and drafting outreach
  • Customer Agent resolving support tickets from your knowledge base
  • Content Agent generating blog posts, landing pages and emails on-brand
  • Social Media Agent
  • Breeze Intelligence enriching records with firmographic and buyer-intent data
  • form shortening using enriched data
  • AI-generated reports and forecasts
  • Breeze Studio for custom agents.

Practical use cases

  • Enriching inbound leads with company data automatically
  • letting an agent draft and personalise outbound sequences
  • deflecting support tickets with a knowledge-base agent
  • generating campaign content grounded in CRM data
  • shortening forms while still capturing full firmographics.

Who is it for?

  • Marketing, sales and service teams already using HubSpot CRM; SMB to mid-market companies.

Pricing, free access & limits

Bundled into HubSpot Hub subscriptions; Breeze Intelligence sold as credit packs

Plans described in the source

Breeze Copilot and core AI features are included at no extra cost across HubSpot tiers, including some free CRM features. HubSpot Hubs: Starter from around $15-20/seat/mo, Professional from around $800-890/mo (Marketing Hub, with seat minimums), Enterprise from around $3,600/mo. Breeze Intelligence is sold separately in credit packs (historically around $30 for 100 credits up to volume pricing). Breeze agents have usage limits varying by tier. HubSpot pricing is complex and contact-tier based - model carefully.

Free plan

Yes - HubSpot's free CRM tier includes limited Breeze AI features.

Free trial

Yes - free trials of Professional tiers available; the free CRM tier is permanent.

Usage limits to consider

Breeze Intelligence is credit-metered and enrichment credits are consumed per record. Agent usage limits vary by Hub tier. Marketing Hub pricing scales with marketing contact volume, which is where costs escalate unexpectedly.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • AI that is grounded in your actual CRM data rather than generic - this is the whole value proposition and it works
  • Breeze Intelligence enrichment removes a separate data-vendor line item for many teams
  • agents are included rather than priced as an add-on, which is unusually generous
  • the free CRM tier with AI is a real on-ramp.

Limitations to consider

  • HubSpot's overall pricing is notoriously escalating - marketing contact tiers and seat minimums push costs up sharply as you grow, and Professional starts around $800/mo
  • Breeze Intelligence credits add another meter
  • AI quality is good but not frontier-level
  • you are buying into the HubSpot ecosystem, which is a significant lock-in decision
  • Arabic support is weak.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android
  • Gmail/Outlook extensions
  • mobile CRM

Languages

  • Interface in 10+ languages; AI content generation multilingual including French; Arabic support is limited

API access

Yes - extensive HubSpot APIs across CRM, CMS, marketing and automation

Integrations and exports

  • 1,700+ apps in the HubSpot marketplace including Salesforce, Slack, Gmail, Outlook, Zoom, Shopify, WordPress, Stripe, LinkedIn, Google Ads

Evaluation notes

Model the total cost at your projected contact count and seat mix, not at today's - HubSpot's pricing escalation is the single most common source of buyer regret. Breeze itself is included, so evaluate HubSpot on the CRM merits first.
